title: Presentándote

sentences.english: Hi, my name is Maria. What's your name?

sentences.spanish: Mucho gusto, María. Soy David.

sentences.english: It's a pleasure to meet you too, David.

options.text: What his name is (Cuál es su nombre)

sentences.english: Is it far from here?

sentences.spanish: No, no está lejos. Como cinco minutos caminando.

questions.questionEnglish: What place are they asking directions to?

questions.answerExplanation: The person says 'No, it's not far' - 'No, no está lejos'.

questions.answerExplanation: The person said 'I'll call you when I land.'

questions.questionEnglish: What does the other person want them to do?
questions.questionSpanish: ¿Qué quiere la otra persona que haga?
questions.answerExplanation: The other person said 'Don't forget to send me pictures!'
